title: Aerospace companies seek patent rights over UFO technology

tellings.quote: authorizes them to get patent rights that's what they want they want to get patent rights uh to technology so that the United States government for the next thousand years

plain: Big aerospace companies want patent rights over recovered UFO technology, so that they, not the US government, would control it "for the next thousand years". That is according to Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, who tells Michels that this is what a 2023 legal change would authorize them to get, without naming a source. He links it to the removal of a provision that would have let the government take such technology over, which he says would leave it in private hands for a very long time.
